figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: the course is one ledger paid in four currencies — heat, work, internal energy and entropy
figures.data: 8 chapters: temperature/kinetic theory, first law, five processes, second law, entropy, Olympiad extensions, playbook
figures.read: one ledger and one tax — every chapter is a line in the accounts, every exam number a balance check
figures.source: course overview (How these notes are organised)

figures.title: The first law ledger: ΔU = Q − W
figures.why: the first law is one line, but its power is bookkeeping — sign by what crosses the boundary
figures.data: ΔU = Q − W (W by the gas); dU = nC_V dT; free expansion ΔU = W = Q = 0; cyclic ΔU = 0
figures.read: heat and work are route-money; only ΔU is the ledger balance

figures.title: The five processes, one template
figures.why: every process problem is ΔU = Q − W plus one constraint; the table fixes which term is zero
figures.data: isochoric W = 0; isobaric W = nRΔT; isothermal ΔU = 0 (W = Q = nRT ln(V₂/V₁)); adiabatic Q = 0; free expansion all zero
figures.read: name the constraint first and the ledger fills itself in; the isotherm's ln is the hyperbola's area

figures.title: Adiabat vs isotherm: which curve pays its own way
figures.why: the two curves answer every "which does more work / ends where" MCQ without algebra
figures.data: adiabat is steeper (γ > 1); for a given expansion it lies below and ends colder; W_adia = nC_V(T₁−T₂), W_iso = nRT ln(V₂/V₁)
figures.read: the lower curve is always the one that pays for expansion out of savings

figures.title: Engine vs refrigerator: two devices, opposite signs
figures.why: the second law is one picture read two ways; arrow directions fix every efficiency-and-COP sign
figures.data: engine W = Q₁ − Q₂; refrigerator COP = Q₂/W; ceilings η_C = 1 − T₂/T₁ and COP_C = T₂/(T₁ − T₂)
figures.read: kelvins only — a Celsius "efficiency" is the classic 30-point trap (§8.2)

figures.title: Triage: which of the four models is this?
figures.why: the same ninety seconds — classify before computing; the class chooses the first written line and the check
figures.data: cycle → W from the loop; state change → ΔU from T only; transfer → Q = nCΔT or a latent step; estimate → one exponent
figures.read: mis-triage (running a cycle as one long state change) costs more marks than any algebra slip
